questions.question: Mention briefly about the meaning of loss aversion in prospect theory (10 × 2 = 20)
questions.solution_html:
• Prospect theory holds that people tend to place a greater weight on the potential for loss than
  • the probability of gain when choosing among options. Key components include loss aversion
  • where people feel losses more acutely than equivalent gains; reference dependence , where
  • decisions are evaluated relative to a reference point, not absolute outcomes; and probability
  • weighting, where small probabilities are often overweighted and large ones are
  • underweighted.(Hint: Give maximum marks if the student correctly stated the concept of ponzi
  • scheme)
